purpose: Improve classification accuracy while retaining the task's primary three-class Log Loss evaluation.
official_dev_policy: Already inspected in the prior experiment; no candidate or checkpoint selection using dev. Evaluate locked candidates together and disclose that it is not a new blind test.

head_capacity.selection: Mean best held-out tune Log Loss across all three training seeds; also retain Accuracy-selected checkpoints separately.

head_optimization.conditional_scope: Capacity winner; do not claim a global optimum across every architecture and optimizer.
ablations: remove training A/B swap; symmetric prediction remains

task_encoder.inputs: Shared encoder jointly encodes (prompt, answer_a) and (prompt, answer_b).
task_encoder.selection: Best held-out tune Log Loss; preserve best-Accuracy checkpoint if available. Single-seed candidate with the limitation disclosed.

final_refit.head_policy: Use the chosen training configuration and predeclared median best epoch across seeds; average three seed models for an optional ensemble.
final_refit.encoder_policy: Use the fit-only selection's chosen epoch and original seed; do not use calibration or dev labels for fitting.
final_refit.scheduler_policy: Freeze the per-epoch median observed learning-rate schedule across seeds; never adjust final refit using tune or calibration labels.
final_refit.encoder_parallel_policy: After the candidate shows first-epoch held-out tune Log Loss <=1.03, a separate GPU may refit for the predeclared maximum 5 epochs and preserve every epoch. Select the final epoch only from the fit-only candidate tuning result; no choice using refit fit-probe, calibration or dev.

calibration.primary_candidate: Lowest calibration Log Loss; tie-break by higher Accuracy then smaller calibration adjustment.
calibration.accuracy_candidate: Highest calibration Accuracy among candidates with Log Loss at most primary Log Loss + 0.005; tie-break by lower Log Loss.

session_export: Only the project's identified root Codex session and recursively related child sessions; raw JSONL snapshots at complete record boundaries with SHA256 manifest.
